# Remotion Studio

The preview reference for Remotion work: start Remotion Studio as soon as a project can run, keep it open while building the composition so the user can see changes and steer, and use npx remotion studio (or --no-open with an in-app browser) with the documented --log, --port and --force-new flags. Studio is a long-running local server in the user's own project; no licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing. Curated by Skill Harbor — Remotion Studio, by @remotion-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
